items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I did a lot of things with Gene Krupa where they used most of the Condon Band

ctx.x: Well, you didn't always take the band with you - frequently, you went by yourself.
No, I'd usually take some of the guys out of the band if they wanted to go. I'd take Gene if he wanted to go and Cutty gladly and any of the clarinet players that wanted to go, I'd take.

Now, the main break you made at permanent; Condon's and you almost made it it came in about what - 1951 - when you formed that band that was such an outstanding band; you had Joe Barufaldi - called himself Joe Barry--
